methodologyNotes: Re-verified via WebFetch on official pricing pages on 2026-06-15: Pendo (pendo.io/pricing), WalkMe (walkme.com/pricing), Userpilot (userpilot.com/pricing), Appcues (appcues.com/pricing), Chameleon (chameleon.io/plans), Whatfix (whatfix.com/pricing), UserGuiding (userguiding.com/pricing). Userflow's pricing page returned HTTP 403, so its figures were corroborated via Apty, G2, and UserGuiding's pricing blog. Pendo, WalkMe, Appcues, and Whatfix publish no paid-plan prices (all require sales contact) -> monthlyUsd null. Chameleon's official Startup price is $279/mo billed annually (the draft's $333/mo and $4,000/yr could not be confirmed on the live page or any third-party source and were removed; multiple 2026 sources and Vendr confirm $279/mo = $3,348/yr). UserGuiding annual rates $174/$349 confirmed on the live page; monthly-billing rates corrected to $290/$580 (draft's $249/$499 were wrong) and annual discount corrected to ~40% (draft said 30%). Userpilot Starter $299/mo (annual) confirmed; Growth/Enterprise are custom. Userflow Startup $300/$240 and Pro $850/$680 (20% annual discount) confirmed via corroborating sources. All accessedAt = 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Product Fruits
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched the Product Fruits pricing page (https://productfruits.com/pricing) via fetch-clean.mjs on 2026-07-10; it renders USD figures directly. Pricing is framed by monthly active users ("See exactly what you'll pay based on your monthly active users"). At the minimum 1,500-MAU slider position the Starter plan shows "$96 /month" annotated "25% off billed annually" and "Save $396", with Pro and Business both at "$149 /month" and a quote-only Custom plan. The page lists only a free trial ("The trial is completely free, no credit card is required"), no $0-forever plan, so freeTier=false. Security row explicitly states "SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 certification, GDPR compliance" (soc2=true); no HIPAA/BAA mention anywhere (hipaa=null). All six integrations verified in the feature comparison table. Confirmed this is Product Fruits' own onboarding product, not a sibling. No corroboration was needed because the pricing page itself carries the USD figures.

vendors.name: Dock
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched the Dock pricing page (https://www.dock.us/pricing) via the fetch-clean script on 2026-07-10. It renders all prices natively in USD, so no corroboration source is required. Verbatim from the fetched page: Free "$ 0 forever", Standard "$ 350 per month" (for growing teams), Premium "$ 1,000 per month, billed annually", Enterprise "Custom annual contract". Standard at $350/mo is the lowest self-serve paid monthly plan and is the entry price (entryMonthlyUsd=350, entryPlanName=Standard). The comparison table Standard column confirms: 5 users included, additional seats $50/mo, Workspaces Unlimited, CMS assets 100, Salesforce ✓, HubSpot ✓, Priority support ✓. The "$ 0 forever" Free plan confirms freeTier=true. Integrations confirmed on the same table: Slack + MS Teams, Call recorders (Gong, Chorus, Fathom…), Embeds (Loom, PandaDoc…), Salesforce, HubSpot. Correct vendor/product: page is dock.us (Dock Labs, Inc.), and Customer Onboarding is a listed Dock product. HIPAA and SOC 2 are not stated anywhere on the page (only a generic Trust Center link, no explicit SOC 2 claim), so both remain null.
